stories.headline: JPMorgan Expands Private Banking Presence in Dubai and U.S. Hires
stories.summary: JPMorgan secured approval to open a regulated private banking branch in the Dubai International Financial Centre and hired senior private banking advisers in the U.S.

stories.headline: Anthropic Plans IPO Live Stream With JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon
stories.summary: Anthropic PBC is planning a live-streamed event featuring CEO Dario Amodei discussing the company's initial public offering with JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon.
stories.quote: Anthropic PBC is planning a live-streamed event, at which co-founder and Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei will discuss the Claude chatbot maker’s initial public offering with JPMorgan Chase & Co. CEO Jamie Dimon, according to a person familiar with the matter.

stories.headline: Senate Democrats Prepare Investigation Into JPMorgan Relationship With Epstein
stories.summary: Senate Democrats are preparing to investigate JPMorgan Chase's historical banking relationship with Jeffrey Epstein, focusing on decisions made by executive Mary Erdoes.
stories.quote: They aim to focus in particular on the Epstein-related decisions made by Mary Erdoes, CEO of the bank's Asset & Wealth Management business, according to the source.
